title: Leisure music pack
body: Tired of the same old jingles? Unwind with this resource pack that swaps the standard music discs for a curated set of chill, lo-fi tracks. Designed to blend seamlessly with Minecraft’s peaceful ambiance, these soothing replacements add a layer of calm and warmth to your builds. Perfect for long nights at the base, farming, or simply watching the sun set over your world.
